item.description: A painting once thought to be by a follower of Julius Caesar Ibbetson turned out to be an early creation of JMW Turner. item.title: Ohio father's lawsuit over son's fatal shooting after highway crash is revived by US appeals court
item.description: In the wake of his son Elijah Isham's fatal shooting by police, Ralph Isham filed a civil rights lawsuit that faced initial dismissal over legal representation concerns. item.title: Mother and daughter killed in grizzly bear attack, Canadian authorities confirm
item.description: Conservation officers say more than one bear may have been involved in attack on women near their home Search teams in Canada have discovered the body of a 20-year-old woman and confirmed that both she and her mother were killed in an attack that conservation officers now believe could have involved multiple grizzly bears.
